name: Elements Online
storyline: In São Paulo, magic has brought everyday objects to life. Creatures now roam the city’s parks and subway stations, and the ghost stories students tell in school hallways have come true. One of those stories is about the Loira do Banheiro, a ghost said to haunt school bathrooms. For adventurers in São Paulo, a familiar place can hold an encounter straight out of a Brazilian urban legend.
summary: Elements Online is a side-scrolling, pixel art MMORPG set in a fantasy version of São Paulo, Brazil. Players explore neighborhoods, schools, parks, and subway stations, encounter creatures inspired by Brazilian urban legends, and team up in groups of up to four to take on dungeons.
